import io
import zipfile
import re
import urllib.request

assets = {
    'protoc': ('https://github.com/protocolbuffers/protobuf/releases/download/v35.1/protoc-35.1-linux-x86_64.zip', 3633928, '6930ebf62bd4ea607b98fff052596c6ee564b9835b4ce172c75a3f53ae9d91b7'),

}
root = Path('qualification_scratch_go')
for role,(url,size,digest) in assets.items():
    with urllib.request.urlopen(url,timeout=40) as response: raw=response.read(size+1)
    if len(raw)!=size or hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()!=digest:raise ValueError('Wrong inspector dependency: '+role)
    with zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(raw)) as archive:
        source_files=({
            'bin/protoc':'protoc',
            'include/google/protobuf/duration.proto':'include/google/protobuf/duration.proto',
            'include/google/protobuf/timestamp.proto':'include/google/protobuf/timestamp.proto',
            'include/google/protobuf/wrappers.proto':'include/google/protobuf/wrappers.proto',
        } if role=='protoc' else {n:'protobuf_runtime/'+n for n in archive.namelist() if re.fullmatch(r'google/protobuf/(?:[A-Za-z0-9_]+/)*[A-Za-z0-9_]+\.py',n)})
        if role=='wheel' and len(source_files)!=54:raise ValueError('Unexpected published protobuf source inventory')
        for member,relative in source_files.items():
            if archive.namelist().count(member)!=1:raise ValueError('Missing or duplicate archive member')
            dst=root/relative;dst.parent.mkdir(exist_ok=True,parents=True)
            with dst.open('xb') as out:out.write(archive.read(member))
